plain_english_policy: Deny or suspend state-issued permits and licenses to parents who are delinquent in paying court-ordered child support.

effects.rationale: Denying permits and licenses to parents who are delinquent in child support is a restriction on their ability to engage in certain activities.
The policy involves suspending permits and licenses as an enforcement mechanism for unpaid child support, indicating a strict approach to enforcing family responsibilities.

evidence_quote: "Deny or suspend state-issued permits and licenses to parents who are delinquent in paying court-ordered child support." - Source: Questionnaire on Social Issues, Year: 1998, Section: Social Issues, Option d)"
